purpose: Prevent project-held hypotheses, authorial propositions, external mechanisms, null hypotheses and baselines from being collapsed into one misleading count.

origin_classes.AUTHORIAL_PROPOSITION: A proposition explicitly authored as a RAFAELIA/Rafael hypothesis or theorem candidate, with provenance supporting that attribution.
origin_classes.PROJECT_DERIVED_PROPOSITION: A testable proposition derived or normalized inside the project from project material; authorship/novelty is not implied.
origin_classes.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_HYPOTHESIS: A published or externally established mechanism/hypothesis retained as a comparator or target; must not be counted as original authorship.
origin_classes.HISTORICAL_INTERNAL_CLAIM: A claim previously made in project material and retained for audit even when refuted, blocked or superseded.
origin_classes.NULL_HYPOTHESIS: A statistical or methodological null used for falsification; count separately from substantive project hypotheses.
origin_classes.BASELINE_MODEL: A reference model or comparator such as LambdaCDM, ordinary graph distance or linear traversal; not counted as an owned hypothesis unless the project separately formulates a proposition about it.
origin_classes.INFERRED_NORMALIZATION: A proposition reconstructed by the registry from model-comparison or surrounding text rather than stated verbatim; must remain flagged until source wording is recovered.
origin_classes.INTERPRETIVE_SYMBOLIC: Symbolic/philosophical proposition with no operational falsifier; excluded from scientific hypothesis count by default.

count_views.ledger_frontier: All stable/provisional normalized substantive hypothesis IDs represented by the registry, regardless of origin, excluding pure baselines/nulls unless they are separately substantive records.
count_views.project_substantive: AUTHORIAL_PROPOSITION + PROJECT_DERIVED_PROPOSITION + HISTORICAL_INTERNAL_CLAIM + INFERRED_NORMALIZATION, after dedup.
count_views.authorial_only: Only AUTHORIAL_PROPOSITION after provenance review; academic novelty is a separate M0-M4 question.
count_views.null_and_baseline: NULL_HYPOTHESIS and BASELINE_MODEL, reported separately and excluded from authorial/project-substantive totals by default.
count_views.scientific_active: Substantive scientific hypotheses whose state is ACTIVE_UNTESTED, ACTIVE_PARTIAL_EVIDENCE, TOKEN_VAZIO, PROOF_OBLIGATION or BLOCKED_BY_DEPENDENCIES; historical refuted/equivalent records are reported separately.

hard_boundaries: A SOURCE FILE NAMED HYPOTHESES DOES NOT AUTOMATICALLY ESTABLISH AUTHORIAL_ORIGIN

migration.existing_ids: origin_class remains TOKEN_VAZIO until source-by-source provenance assignment; do not retroactively guess
migration.future_ids: origin_class required whenever source provenance is sufficient
migration.certified_authorial_total: TOKEN_VAZIO until migration and dedup are complete
